test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

In accordance to / the factual data, / serious measures are required / to control the loss.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect preposition "**to**" in the phrase "**In accordance to**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**In accordance with**", as this is the correct preposition used with the phrase "in accordance".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"In accordance with the factual data, serious measures are required to control the loss."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "the factual data"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "to control the loss"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "serious measures are required"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
